ops.body:
Shipped with explicit user authorization. PR https://github.com/yasyf/captain-hook/pull/120 merged at 9914dacd17022fb68c0e84c803ff75b7e2ced975; generated guides landed at af1c2ec4347c30fb29b1a5ac55b6c44dd008c8d6. Published https://github.com/yasyf/captain-hook/releases/tag/v12.41.0 with successful release workflow 35281520736, signed/notarized app, PyPI artifacts, plugin manifest, and Homebrew formula.

Local update verified: Homebrew formula, deployed signed app, helper, daemon, all running workers, standalone CLI, and all existing user/local Claude plugin scopes report 12.41.0. First supported installer safely restored 12.40.0 while a prior hook client still held the executable; that client exited and the supported retry succeeded. No manual app replacement or deployment-record changes.

Five live PreToolUse checks through the installed signed host passed: both observed root scans denied, repeated scan denied again, shallow root listing allowed, scoped search allowed. Evidence: /tmp/capt-hook-12.41.0-live-proof.json. Current process inventory shows no find processes. Original repository staged internal/hookd/scheduler_test.go remains untouched; shipping worktree is clean. Overall perceived machine responsiveness was not independently confirmed.
